crossRefs.note: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second…
You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have…
Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water…
He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

translations.web: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.
translations.bsb: he consulted with his leaders and mighty men about stopping up the waters of the springs outside the city, and they helped him carry it out.
translations.kjv: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
translations.asv: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city; and they helped him.
